text: The Unilever Precinct is set to transform from its industrial and manufacturing past into a vibrant urban district. New flood protection, transit, transportation, and servicing infrastructure enables this transformation and will connect the Precinct to its surroundings and the broader city. The Precinct’s major street network, established through the 2017 Council-endorsed Port Lands and South of Eastern Transportation and Servicing Master Plan, connects to and through the new East Harbour Transit Hub. In the future, the area will be a walkable and transit-oriented place, with vibrant and complete streets that connect people to jobs, recreation, amenities and most other daily needs. It is expected that 90 percent of future trips in the area will be made by people walking, cycling, or taking transit.
